 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Paris Saint-Germain are without several key players for their visit to face Le Havre AC in Ligue 1 on Friday night. Ousmane Dembélé, Marquinhos, and Nuno Mendes are all not yet fit enough to return to the fold.
 PSG must also contend with the long-term absence of Khvicha Kvaratskhelia. Against Les Ciel et Marine on Friday night, it is Quentin Ndjantou who is expected to start on the left of the attack and it could be another academy product, Senny Mayulu, who could lead the line at the Stade Océane.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Luis Enrique is looking to rest key players ahead of a UEFA Champions League encounter against Villarreal on Tuesday night. As a result, the likes of Lucas Beraldo, Dro Fernandez, Lucas Digne, and Lucas Hernandez could all also start for Les Parisiens. 
 PSG likely line-up v Le Havre
 Matvey Safonov; Lucas Digne, Lucas Hernandez, Illia Zabarnyi, Warren Zaire-Emery; Joao Neves, Lucas Beraldo, Dro Fernandez; Quentin Ndjantou, Senny Mayulu, Ferran Torres. (L'Éq)
